card.name: Linking words before cheating or fraud
card.fires_on: Small linking words and number pieces right before an expected cheating, fraud or dishonesty term, in web text about cheating, academic integrity, food fraud or search-ranking manipulation.

modes.label: Cheating and academic integrity
modes.description: A linking word such as who, of or a digit just before cheating or academic dishonesty wording.
modes.example: insurance-holders<< who>> cheat on their claims

modes.label: Food fraud and manipulation
modes.description: A small word before fraud, dilution or gaming of rankings, in food fraud or search engine text.
modes.example: Olive oils were<< often>> replaced and/or diluted with cheaper vegetable oils

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce fraud, cheating and dishonest words next.
card.plain: It lights up on small words just before the text is about to say cheating or fraud.
